hooks.name: TODO guard (keep the pet's home clean)
hooks.description: Stops new TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers from piling up silently in Repogotchi's own source.

action.prompt: Check whether the file just saved contains TODO, FIXME, HACK or XXX markers (whole words). If there are none, do nothing and say nothing. For each marker: if it can be resolved in under ~10 lines without changing the spec, resolve it. Otherwise, leave it in place and make sure it is listed in docs/known-gaps.md with file:line, a one-sentence description and the related requirement ID from .kiro/specs/repogotchi/requirements.md. Never add new markers yourself.
